title: 第六十三章唯一的路第六十二章马得水的目的
slug: 扫地八十年从宗门杂役飞升成仙
lines: 第六十三章唯一的路
叶凡就那么站着，平静的看着马得水。
他那双眼睛，经历过四次九龙搬血功法的焚烧与重塑，早已不复九旬老者的浑浊，也并非壮年人的锐利。
那是一种深不见底的幽暗，是古井，也是深渊，能将投射进去的光线、情绪、乃至杀意，尽数吞噬，不起半点波澜。
马得水被他看的心理发毛。
这不对劲。
一个被几十把剑指着、人赃并获的锻体境废物，怎么可能是这种反应？
他不该是惊慌失措、跪地求饶吗？或者色厉内荏、破口大骂也行。
可这种平静，这种仿佛在看一场与自己无关的闹剧的眼神，让马得水精心准备的满腔怒火，全都无处发泄，说不出的憋闷。
“你看什么看！”
马得水被这种无声的蔑视激怒，上前一步，将手的黑木盒子几乎怼到叶凡脸上，唾沫星子横飞。
“证据确凿！你还有什么话好说？！”
他身后的几十名外门弟子也跟着鼓噪起来，剑尖又向前递了几分，森然的剑气几乎要贴上叶凡的皮肤。
火把的光芒在每个人的脸上跳跃，映出一张张或贪婪、或麻木、或幸灾乐祸的脸。
叶凡的视线终于从马得水那张涨成猪肝色的胖脸上移开。
他没有去看那所谓的物证，甚至连一丝好奇都没有。
他的目光，缓缓的、一个一个的，扫过那三个最先冲进来栽赃的弟子。
那三人被他看的浑身不自在，下意识的想避开他的视线，却发现自己像是被无形的钉子钉在了原地，动弹不得。
然后，他们听到了叶凡的声音。
不急不缓，清晰的传进每个人的耳朵里。
“马管事给了你们什么好处？”
叶凡的声音很平淡，像是在问今天天气怎么样。
“让你们……连命都不要了？”
话音落下的瞬间，那三名弟子脸色齐齐一白！
一股寒气，毫无征兆的从他们尾椎骨直冲天灵盖。
他们感觉自己面对的不是一个锻体四阶的同门，而是一头刚刚从血池里爬出来的远古凶兽，正用那双幽暗的眸子，决定着从他们身上的哪个部位开始下口。
“你……你胡说八道什么！”
为首那名弟子强撑着，声音却止不住的发颤。
“死到临头还敢嘴硬！”
“马管事，别跟他废话了，拿下他！”
他们的反应，彻底点燃了马得水心中最后一丝耐性。
叶凡的轻蔑，这三个废物的胆怯，都让他感觉这场完美的戏码出现了瑕疵。
他不能再等了，夜长梦多！
“好！好一个不知死活的魔道奸细！”

Chapter 63 The only way
Ye Fan just stood there, looking at Ma Deshui calmly.
His eyes had experienced the burning and reshaping of the Nine Dragons Blood Movement Technique four times, and they were no longer as turbid as those of a ninety-year-old man, nor were they as sharp as those of a mature man.
It is a kind of bottomless darkness, an ancient well and an abyss. It can swallow up all the light, emotions, and even murderous intentions projected into it without causing any waves.
Ma Deshui was shocked by what he saw.
This isn't right.
How could a body-forging-level waste who was pointed at by dozens of swords and taken away from others react like this?
Shouldn't he be panicking and kneeling down to beg for mercy? Or you can be fierce and angry, and curse loudly.
But this calmness, this look as if he was watching a farce that had nothing to do with him, made Ma Deshui's well-prepared anger unable to be vented, leaving him feeling unspeakably depressed.
"What are you looking at!"
Ma Deshui was angered by this silent contempt. He took a step forward and almost hit Mark's face with the black wooden box in his hand, spittle flying everywhere.
"The evidence is conclusive! What else do you have to say?!"
The dozens of outer disciples behind him also started making noises. The tip of the sword was moved forward a little more, and the strong sword energy almost touched Ye Fan's skin.
The light of the torch danced on everyone's face, reflecting faces that were either greedy, numb, or gloating about one's misfortune.
Ye Fan finally moved his eyes away from Ma Deshui's fat face that turned the color of pig liver.
He didn't look at the so-called physical evidence, not even a trace of curiosity.
His eyes slowly swept over the three disciples who were the first to rush in and frame them up one by one.
The three people felt uncomfortable when he looked at them, and they subconsciously wanted to avoid his sight, but found that they seemed to be nailed to the spot by invisible nails, unable to move.
Then, they heard Ye Fan's voice.
No rush, no slowness, and it reaches everyone's ears clearly.
"What benefits has Manager Ma given you?"
Ye Fan's voice was very calm, as if he was asking what the weather was like today.
"Let you... even risk your lives?"
The moment the words fell, the faces of the three disciples all turned pale!
A gust of cold air shot straight from their tailbones to the Tianling Cap without any warning.
They felt that they were not facing a fellow disciple of the fourth level of body training, but an ancient ferocious beast that had just crawled out of the blood pool. It was using its dark eyes to decide which part of their bodies to start eating.
"You...what are you talking about!"
The leading disciple held on, but his voice couldn't stop trembling.
"You dare to speak harshly even when you are about to die!"
"Guanshi Ma, stop talking nonsense to him and capture him!"
Their reactions completely ignited the last bit of patience in Ma Deshui's heart.
Ye Fan's contempt and the cowardice of these three losers made him feel that there was a flaw in this perfect drama.
He can't wait any longer, the nights are long and the dreams are many!
"Good! What a devilish spy who doesn't know how to live or die!"
